sBPF ELF parsing, relocation, program loading, and version feature checks.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for the `fd_sbpf_loader`, which prepares an sBPF program for execution by parsing the ELF file, applying dynamic relocation, and loading the read-only and text data into memory. It declares error codes, SBPF version constants, feature checks, and data types such as `fd_sbpf_elf_info_t`, `fd_sbpf_program_t`, and `fd_sbpf_syscalls_t` that describe the parsed file, the loaded program, and the syscall registry. The file also provides prototypes for [`fd_sbpf_elf_peek`](<#fd_sbpf_elf_peek>), [`fd_sbpf_program_new`](<#fd_sbpf_program_new>), [`fd_sbpf_program_load`](<#fd_sbpf_program_load>), and [`fd_sbpf_program_delete`](<#fd_sbpf_program_delete>), which together support the full load lifecycle. In addition, it defines version-dependent helper functions that enable or disable SBPF features based on the program version.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_sbpf_elf_peek`
- `fd_sbpf_program_align`
- `fd_sbpf_program_footprint`
- `fd_sbpf_program_new`
- `fd_sbpf_program_load`
- `fd_sbpf_program_delete`
